label: USGS Earthquakes → TAK
info:
Earthquakes of any magnitude from the past hour, inside Tennessee (plus a small buffer).

Data: USGS earthquake GeoJSON feed (https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/feed/v1.0/geojson.php). Updates every 60 seconds.

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Channel name and CoT type are at the top of the Build CoT (TN bbox) function.
3. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/usgs-earthquakes
